open_items: The paper prints 77 completers and 75 analyzed participants (PDF p. 10, printed p. 1032), but not the number randomized. The sensitivity analysis has group sizes 38 and 37 without named arms (PDF p. 12, printed p. 1034). No named arm counts are inferred.

Human-level shortlist quality excludes four AI-arm participants, but the resulting analysis count is not printed. Human-level robustness counts are not explicit; whether shortlist exclusions affect long-list Good-Idea-Counts is unclear. These estimate counts remain null.

No participant-level SDs, SEs, numerical confidence intervals, or raw mean differences are printed. Only dyad-level human-rated novelty has arm means. Fig. 8c interval type and endpoints are unspecified; no values are read off figures.
Human-fluency text p = 0.015 conflicts with Fig. 7a ** and caption **p < .01 (PDF pp. 12-13, printed pp. 1034-1035). The text value is extracted and the discrepancy retained.

Human-fluency Cohen's d is positive 0.581 although rank-biserial r is -0.324 and the AI-arm median is lower. Conversion formula and SD standardizers are not stated; no signs or standardizers are reconstructed.

Online Appendices A-E are absent from the saved PDF and unavailable locally. On 2026-10-10, Python urllib requests with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1 to https://media.springernature.com/full/springer-static/esm/art%3A10.1007%2Fs12599-025-00974-y/MediaObjects/12599_2025_974_MOESM1_ESM.pdf and https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12599-025-00974-y both failed with WinError 10013 (network access denied). Supplemental numerical contents remain unverified.

Good-Idea-Count novelty threshold 3.396 (PDF p. 13, printed p. 1035, Sect. 4.1) duplicates the human-rated dyad novelty treatment mean in Sect. 4.2. The printed threshold is retained; Appendix D or author clarification would resolve any suspected duplication.
Possible sample overlap with c861 and related reports remains unresolved, as flagged by the screening form.
The paper identifies neither human-level nor dyad-level novelty as primary; the primary-record choice remains for Atlas reconciliation.

The paper states a Western European university, without an explicit study country (PDF p. 11, printed p. 1033). Model release year is not explicit. These fields remain null. lab_rct follows the in-person seminar setting; ordinary-coursework status is unclear.

notes: The entire markdown was read, including references; it contains no appendices. Cited main-PDF pages were checked with PyMuPDF. Random assignment is explicit in Sect. 3.2, but its mechanism is not stated. Sessions were in university seminars, with one human per dyad. The common analyzed count is used where no further exclusions are stated; unprinted counts for human-level shortlist quality and robustness analyses remain null. No across-person diversity or after-AI outcomes are reported. Flexibility is within-person category breadth. Human and dyad outcomes share participants and controls; robustness outcomes are not independent samples. Applicable stats objects add treatment_median and control_median to preserve medians separately from means; human fluency adds rank_biserial_r alongside Cohen's d. All added numbers have field-specific sources. Quotes retain printed precision; only PDF wrapping, ligatures, and mapped plus/less-than characters are normalized. No statistics or participant counts were calculated. Extraction date: 2026-10-10.
